statement: The frame covers at most 15 % of any prop's disc, seen from above
rationale: Material under a prop blocks its downwash and costs thrust; the review's propwash point. Each seat sits in the middle of its disc, so whatever holds it stiffly crosses the disc: the stiffest organic frame covered 22 %, and one held to 8.5 % was 2.9x less stiff. The author chose the middle (2026-10-17): 15 %, which costs about 7.5 % of static thrust (blockage costs roughly half its area fraction), A1's figure.

mechanism.how: the frame cut by each prop's annulus and projected onto the plane
